description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget for the menu screen of a restaurant app, displaying categorized menu items, with options to select portions and add items to a shopping cart.

classes.name: MenuScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that builds the main menu interface, including tabbed categories, item listings, and cart navigation.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the menu screen, includes loading indicator, tabs for categories, list of menu items with options, and a navigation button to the cart.
